productFacts.label: Linear model definition
productFacts.value: λ = I/Isat; P(n≥1) = 1−exp(−λ); fluorescence fit a[1−exp(−I/Isat)]+c; Isat corresponds to 1−1/e ≈0.6 of maximum.

productFacts.label: UC model and approximations
productFacts.value: Photon-pair weighting P(2)+2P(3)+3P(4)+… multiplied by UC efficiency; pulse-duration dependence and differences in interband/intraband absorption cross sections neglected.
productFacts.scope: The SI prose says at least 2 pairs although its series starts P(2); preserve source wording/formula without inventing a four-photon mechanism.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
